create_LiteLLM_backend: create a LiteLLM backend instance with a model name and optional api_key, base_url, and timeout parameters
initialize_LiteLLM_with_params: initialize a LiteLLM backend with model_name, api_key, organization, base_url, timeout, and max_retries
get_chat_template_from_backend: get the chat template configured for a LiteLLM backend instance
generate_completion_from_backend: generate a text completion from a LiteLLM backend given a StreamExecutor and sampling params
generate_stream_from_backend: generate a streamed text completion from a LiteLLM backend given a StreamExecutor and sampling params
